experiment: phase 9, child 8 - does an account mapping transfer between organisations?

contract_change.headline: The output hash has moved twice, both times on 2026-08-10, and the finding did not change either time. The most recent move is first.

moves.why: Phase 8 PR-2 root-cause fix. accountant/detect/detectors.py:prior_amounts stopped counting rows that are not dated before an entry into that entry's magnitude ceiling. Three DHSC false alarms were raised against a history dated the same day as the entry itself, which is not history, and they are gone.
moves.how_much_of_the_text_changed: two lines of the 147-line experiment text, measured by unified diff: the DHSC within-department row went from 'false alarms 7 / N1 33.33% / questions 14/21' to 'false alarms 4 / N1 19.05% / questions 13/21', and the all-departments question total went from 51/143 to 50/143. Four changed lines in total, two removed and two added. Every other byte is identical.
moves.re_earned_not_edited: all 10 runs were executed again on this branch, five seeds twice each, and each reported the new hash independently. No hash was copied from another run and none was find-and-replaced.

moves.headline: The output hash moved on 2026-08-10. The number was not quietly swapped, and the finding did not change.
moves.why: Owner decision D-05 (2026-08-10) rules that a company's legal form is part of its identity and must not be stripped as noise. accountant/memory/index.py:normalise_vendor therefore keeps it: "Accenture (UK) Ltd" now folds to accenture_uk_ltd, where before D-05 it folded to accenture_uk. That supplier key is printed in the experiment text, so the text's bytes changed, so its sha256 changed.
moves.how_much_of_the_text_changed: one token, in one place. Taking the new 147-line experiment text and substituting accenture_uk_ltd back to accenture_uk reproduces 83cc858f42443fa7aa0753d7ece774337be4cb54d5d8260c1d8dfdfac68f12f4 exactly. Every other byte, and so every number, is identical.
moves.re_earned_not_edited: the 11 hashes below were not find-and-replaced from a single run. All 10 runs were executed again on this branch, at all five seeds, and each reported the new hash independently.
moves.import_provenance: every run was executed with cwd set to this worktree, and accountant.__file__ was asserted to resolve inside it before the text was produced. A run whose accountant resolved to another checkout would have raised, not been recorded.

configuration_covers: sha256 over pyproject.toml then ci/gates.toml, path then bytes

environment.git_commit_is: the commit every measured module came from. accountant/ingest/, accountant/ingest/crossorg.py and accountant/score/harness.py are byte-identical to the ones the first measurement used. accountant/memory/index.py is NOT: owner decision D-05 changed how it folds a supplier name, and that is the whole reason the output hash moved. See contract_change below.
environment.network: none - every byte read came from a committed fixture; accountant/ingest/fetch.py was not called

why_five_seeds: two runs in one process share a hash seed, so they cannot catch set or dict iteration order leaking into the output. Five seeds including one chosen at random can.

not_measurable.number: N2, review time as a fraction of read-everything time
not_measurable.reason: N2 needs R (seconds to read one entry) and D (seconds to dismiss one flag). Both are self-timed inputs and nobody has supplied them. The harness refuses to invent a default, and so does this manifest.

not_measurable.number: N3, catch rate per injected error type
not_measurable.reason: nobody injected errors into a real government ledger, so there is no answer key. The harness reports FAIL on absent evidence rather than a vacuous PASS.

the Department for Business and Trade publishes the narration column and leaves every cell in it empty. 0 of 28 committed rows load, all 28 rejected for empty narration, so DBT cannot be either side of a pair.
no Indian transaction-level ledger data is published. This corpus tests the mechanism and the transfer question only.
